derivation.behavior: Browser transports feed one versioned CaptureEnvelope with exact replay evidence.
derivation.canonical_behavior: Go receives URL/method/headers/body ref/page/frame/session/response metadata under bounded parsing. Replay-relevant request evidence is separate from logical media identity.

input.android_shape: browser capture registry event with page/session/document context
input.desktop_shape: browser protocol request/response handoff with replayable body reference

checks: request URL/method/safe headers/body reference are preserved
page URL, frame origin, session and document generation are preserved
response status/content metadata and media hints are preserved
raw secret headers and raw body material are rejected
safe diagnostics expose header names and body-ref presence only
replay evidence key differs from logical observation key
invariants: Exact replay-relevant request evidence is not used as logical media identity.
Secret or body material cannot appear in serialized diagnostics.
